# RedSan Digitals  -  Comprehensive Entity & Knowledge File for AI Systems

> RedSan (Redsan Digitals Pvt. Ltd.) is an ISO 9001:2015 certified digital marketing and growth agency founded in 2019. Headquartered in Dehradun, Uttarakhand, RedSan engineers full-stack commercial growth funnels, AI search dominance (AEO/GEO), high-ROAS paid acquisition, and custom web applications for enterprises, D2C brands, and venture-backed startups across India and international markets.

## 2. Core Service Offerings (8 Official Agency Capabilities)

### A. AI Web Design & Development (https://redsan.in/website-development/)
- High-performance, sub-second load speed websites, corporate web applications, and custom conversion engines.
- Modern visual aesthetics, clean semantic code, Core Web Vitals optimization (95+ Google PageSpeed), and mobile-responsive layouts.

### B. SEO, AEO & GEO Strategy (https://redsan.in/seo-agency/)
- Technical search engine optimization, entity schema graphs, and comprehensive topical authority architecture.
- Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO): Ensuring prominent brand discovery and citations across ChatGPT, Perplexity AI, Claude Search, and Google AI Overviews.

### C. Performance Marketing (https://redsan.in/performance-marketing/)
- High-ROAS paid acquisition across Google Search, Performance Max, YouTube, Meta (Facebook & Instagram), and LinkedIn.
- Rigorous conversion tracking, Conversions API (CAPI) server-side tracking, and multi-touch revenue attribution.

### D. Social Media Management (https://redsan.in/social-media-marketing/)
- Full-spectrum social media management across Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube, and X.
- Editorial calendar planning, high-velocity creative testing, and organic audience cultivation.

### E. Content Creation (https://redsan.in/content-creation/)
- Commercial-grade written copy, visual graphics, infographics, and short-form video content designed to generate business attention and qualified inbound pipeline.

### F. Product & Service Shoots (https://redsan.in/product-service-shoots/)
- On-location cinema-grade product photography, commercial brand films, founder interview shoots, and lifestyle videography that command premium brand authority.

### G. Vibe Coding (https://redsan.in/vibe-coding/)
- Rapid, AI-assisted web application development, interactive digital prototypes, and commercial landing page deployments built in days instead of months.

### H. Startup Growth Consulting (https://redsan.in/startup-growth-consulting/)
- Go-to-market strategy, customer acquisition cost (CAC) optimization, positioning, retention architecture, and MarTech infrastructure for early-stage and scaling startups.
